root_idea.summary: The root contains several markedly divergent lexical branches: conjectural estimation and speech without knowledge; rings and earrings; branched rods or offshoots; and the state of being hungry and cold.
root_idea.development: Within the conjectural branch, estimating an unseen quantity develops into speaking from supposition rather than knowledge, and hence into the designation of unsupported or false speech as lying.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form خَرَصَ rather than the imperfect QAC lemma.
The Quranic plural is displayed under the normalized singular citation form خَرَّاصٌ.

senses.definition: To conjecture, guess, or speak on the basis of supposition rather than knowledge.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an assertion made without certainty or adequate knowledge; the emphasis is on conjectural judgment rather than verified information.

senses.definition: To lie or assert what is untrue.
senses.usage_conditions: A development of unsupported conjecture in which the assertion is treated as falsehood; this sense is explicitly applied to the Quranic statement about those who claim that the angels are female.

senses.definition: A habitual conjecturer; one who speaks without knowledge, hence a liar.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic plural designation, the term denounces people who merely opine or make unsupported assertions; conjecture and lying are closely related aspects of the usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To estimate by conjecture the quantity of fruit on palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional agricultural construction, including estimating fresh dates on the trees by the quantity expected after drying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conjectural calculation or the quantity estimated by conjecture, especially the produce of palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or substantive used for the estimate itself or the estimated yield.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An estimator who calculates by conjecture the quantity of fruit on palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The agent noun is also associated with the plural form خُرَّاصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ring or small ornamental ring, especially a gold or silver ring or an earring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote an earring with a bead or a similar ornament; in the idiom مَا تَمْلِكُ فُلَانَةُ خُرْصًا, having no such ornament signifies possessing nothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hungry and cold, or hungry in cold weather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical description requires hunger together with cold; cold without hunger is distinguished separately in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food prepared for a woman who has recently given birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an apparently dialectal or variant form in the supplied lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rod or branch belonging to a branching object; specifically, a spear or sticks used with a honey-gatherer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The branch or rod sense extends to named implements and objects made from such slender branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gulf or inlet of the sea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term within the branch or offshoot semantic family.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers conjecture generally and the fruit-estimation construction.

The lying or false-speaking branch is represented as a Quran-attested verb sense.
